bootstrap.note: Completion-adjusted panel intervals condition on the named readers; the report's panel intervals also resample readers.

estimands.main_table: Mean of observed repeat correctness within question, then equally across observed questions; directly format unrounded mean to three decimals.
estimands.completion_adjusted: Correct observed answers / (158 questions x 3 planned reads); every non-observed planned read contributes zero task success.
estimands.completion_scope: the recorded run, route time-outs included
estimands.tier: Equal mean across fixed named readers, paired by question and unit; no tier verdicts recomputed.
estimands.compressor: B readers use DeepSeek-built M6; C readers use their own compressor. B/C differences conflate reader panel and compressor assignment.

population.documents_definition: Unique (family, doc) identifiers; document revisions separately reported below.

gptoss20b_vs_fixed_REF_B.note: recomputed in sorted pair order with its own draws; point estimates must equal exploratory.py, interval endpoints are separate Monte Carlo draws

option_aware_error_mix_check.scope: The constrained panel's four readers, all three reads, primary population, M2/M5_B/M7_B at 4k
option_aware_error_mix_check.definition: exploratory.py's gate (a wrong answer of class E-other/value_not_in_doc), with a literal answer letter resolved to that question's option before testing for none of these or not_in_effect.

primary_resource_check.population: 158 primary questions, three reads each; 474 observed reads in each checked condition

build_amortization.scope: Server and constrained readers, DeepSeek-built summary and records at 4k (the memories of Fig. 2)
build_amortization.weighting: Mean token workload across the primary population's answered reads; not an unweighted mean over unique document revisions
build_amortization.share_definition: mean(build_tokens)/1000 divided by mean(input + output + query_memory_tokens + build_tokens/1000)

example_units_check.scope: All observed reads; retrieval = M2@4000, summary = DeepSeek-built M5@4000; open-weight readers have three reads, the cloud comparator one
